profiles.purpose: Research a bounded scholarly question with explicit work/report/version units and method-specific appraisal.

dimensions.source ecology: Use appropriate scholarly identifiers, author/publisher originals and available status records; a supplied-paper task need not search every database.
dimensions.search strategy: Expand terms and citation paths only within the brief; record search coverage and distinguish a focused check from systematic conduct.
dimensions.inclusion / exclusion rules: Declare eligibility by question and study/design; retain eligible adverse/null findings and separate unavailable full text from exclusion.
dimensions.source appraisal: Appraise the actual design, metrics and transfer limits. Do not apply clinical risk-of-bias tools indiscriminately to computing benchmarks.
dimensions.research methods: Link reports/versions to the underlying work or study and reconcile changed populations/configurations before synthesis.
dimensions.synthesis structure: Present question-to-finding support with unit linkage, method limits and unresolved applicability separately.
dimensions.quality criteria: Check support, status, report linkage, appropriate counting, uncertainty and claims about completeness; no universal score.
dimensions.reporting conventions: Use exact work/version locators and identify the review type actually performed. Reporting checklists cannot certify unperformed conduct.

effects.change: Specify scholarly units, eligibility and an appropriate appraisal method before retrieval.
effects.observable: Plan states which report/study/version is counted and which inference is authorised.

effects.change: Resolve relevant scholarly identities and status within the allowed corpus.
effects.observable: Search/selection record differentiates candidate, eligible, unavailable and superseded representation.

effects.change: Capture method, task/population, measure, units and locators needed for the finding.
effects.observable: No abstract-only record supplies unseen methods.

effects.change: Link multiple reports and revisions before counting or comparing; appraise threshold transfer.
effects.observable: A revised paper cannot become another independent experiment.

effects.change: Expose design limits and study/report structure; keep implications conditional.
effects.observable: A benchmark threshold is not rendered as universal application acceptance.

effects.change: Check the relevant correction/revision and repair affected claims without silently repointing historical evidence.
effects.observable: Unchanged prior findings retain their basis.

effects.change: Add report-linkage, status-boundary and method-transfer checks to applicable core dimensions.
effects.observable: Bibliographic validity and substantive support receive separate verdicts.

showcase.premise: A team needs evidence about advertised long-context capacity, not a model purchasing recommendation.
showcase.constraints: RULER author sources only; no model execution or exhaustive-review claim.
showcase.expected_change: Version-linked unit counting and design-specific threshold applicability, with preserved core findings.

profiles.purpose: Assess open-source adoption evidence using revision, licence, code, package, maintenance and actually executed validation as distinct evidence.

dimensions.source ecology: Use repository files, commits, release and issue records when relevant; distinguish maintainer statements from code and execution evidence.
dimensions.search strategy: Resolve immutable revisions and source paths first; bound any history/issues sample and never imply exhaustive maintenance review.
dimensions.inclusion / exclusion rules: Choose projects against the stated need and licences; popularity is a discovery signal, not suitability or exclusion evidence.
dimensions.source appraisal: Assess ownership, actual maintenance evidence, licence scope and test relevance separately; a green check does not cover all runtime paths.
dimensions.research methods: Compare README, package and deployment facts at the same revision; classify static observations versus executed smoke/failure tests.
dimensions.synthesis structure: Return a revision-bound suitability assessment with environment requirements, evidence kinds, missing tests and bounded adoption conditions.
dimensions.quality criteria: Check code-to-claim traceability, maintenance inference, dependency boundaries and truthful installation/failure status.
dimensions.reporting conventions: Cite file/ref/line or immutable item; label documented, inspected, executed and unknown rather than promoting stars or badges to assurance.

effects.change: Set task-fit criteria, pinned revision, allowed repository evidence and execution authority.
effects.observable: Static-only work cannot acquire install/run authority.

effects.change: Inspect native repository evidence and relevant history/issue samples at declared bounds.
effects.observable: Collection completeness and sampling limits remain explicit.

effects.change: Capture source path/ref/locator and evidence kind, including exact setup and licence scope.
effects.observable: README, package declarations and observed execution remain distinct.

effects.change: Reconcile configuration differences and bind code risks to specific missing tests.
effects.observable: A suspicious branch is recorded as a static finding, not a measured failure rate.

effects.change: Present evidence-qualified reuse conditions rather than a universal repository ranking.
effects.observable: Transitive rights, environment and runtime gaps remain visible.

effects.change: Compare changed revision/files and only reopen affected claims and validations.
effects.observable: A documentation change does not erase unrelated source checks.

effects.change: Check revision identity, licence scope, maintenance/sample inference and static-versus-executed wording.
effects.observable: An unexecuted installation cannot pass as operational readiness.

showcase.premise: A team considers an existing research engine instead of building one.
showcase.constraints: Pinned source set and static assessment only; no installation, code change, payment or deployment.
showcase.expected_change: Cross-file environment reconciliation and evidence-to-test conditions, retaining all known baseline cautions.
